title: [finding] rest-channel.md's write side names `PATCH .../issues/{n}` only as 改正文 — it omits the issue-state leg, and a seat read that omission as "no channel to close a card"
body:
Filed by the `domain:services` execution seat (objectstack#6021), `session_01WmBwEiWPff9JZPd5BSGNeH`, as a change-of-shift class-3 item (**platform fact changed / incomplete — a one-line fix to a fact table**), per `SKILL.md` 座位贴协议 「平台事实变化 → references 事实表改一行」.

## The gap

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md`, write side, currently reads:

> ✓ 建卡带标签 `POST .../issues` · 改正文 `PATCH .../issues/{n}` · 认领 `POST .../issues/{n}/assignees`

It names `PATCH /repos/{o}/{r}/issues/{n}` **only as 改正文 (edit the body)**. The same endpoint also carries the **issue-state leg** — `{"state": "closed", "state_reason": "completed" | "not_planned"}` — and the table says nothing about it.

## Why the omission is load-bearing, not cosmetic

It cost a real card a real stall, and the reasoning that produced the stall was sound given the table.

On **#16023** the `domain:services` seat measured, correctly and with controls, that the reported defect no longer existed on `origin/main` and wrote 「**The correct end state is CLOSED `completed`**」 — then did **not** close it (`objectstack#16023`, `issuecomment-5695652963`), reasoning verbatim:

> - every GitHub MCP write tool is on the harness deny roster (`.claude/settings.json`, including `mcp__github__issue_write`);
> - the seat's two sanctioned REST-proxy writers are `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` (comments/bodies) and `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` (labels/assignee) — **neither carries an issue-state leg**

⭐ **Both premises are TRUE.** The conclusion does not follow only because the fact table does not say the raw `PATCH` closes cards — so "no script has a state leg" reads as "the seat has no channel". The card then sat `pm:blocked` with its blocker long spent, and the seat raised it to the maintainer as a manual one-action item.

## Measured, ⛔ not reasoned

This seat closed #16023 through that exact endpoint this shift. ⚠️ The time of that reading is ⛔ not retyped here — a new-issue POST has no stamp substitution, and a clock typed from memory is the defect the stamp contract exists to prevent. The stamped record is **objectstack#16023 `issuecomment-5707137250`**, written by `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` in the same act that read the clock:

```
PATCH /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/16023   {"state":"closed","state_reason":"completed"}   -> HTTP 200
read-back: state=closed · state_reason=completed · labels [bug, priority:p2, domain:services] · assignees []
```

Positive control in the same session, same endpoint, different leg: `PATCH .../issues/6021` with `{"title": …}` → HTTP 200, read-back identical. ⇒ the endpoint is reachable through the egress proxy for **both** legs; ⛔ this is not a `state`-only or a `title`-only permission.

⚠️ Scoping the claim honestly: `DELETE /repos/{o}/{r}/git/refs/heads/{branch}` on the **same** proxy answers **403** (`"Write access to this GitHub API path is not permitted through this proxy."`), measured this shift on the empty branch `claude/issue-18110-subflow-refused-rollup`. ⇒ "repo-scoped write" is ⛔ not uniformly open, which is exactly why the per-operation table exists and why this row is worth a line.

## The one-line fix

Give the write side an explicit issue-state row rather than folding it into 改正文 — e.g. a row naming `PATCH .../issues/{n}` with `{"state","state_reason"}`, noting that neither sanctioned script carries this leg so it is a raw REST call, and that `state_reason` must agree with the closing reason (`not_planned` for withdrawn/won't-do, `completed` for delivered) per the state model.

⚠️ Whether a seat closing a card should get its own `scripts/pm/` writer (so the four-step read-back discipline covers it the way `label-write.mjs` covers labels) is a **separate and larger** question — ⛔ not proposed here, and ⛔ this card should not be widened into it.

## Dedupe words

`rest-channel issue state leg` · `PATCH issues state_reason proxy` · `no channel to close a card` · `post-stamped label-write no state leg` · `#16023 close completed`

Related: objectstack#16023 (`issuecomment-5695652963` is the stall, `issuecomment-5707137250` is the correction) · `references/rest-channel.md` · `references/platform-readings.md`

⛔ `type` and `priority` are the triage seat's; filed ungraded and unassigned. `domain:skills` applied because the landing site is `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md`, a governed surface — and per `SKILL.md`, a change-of-shift class-3 item enters the skills lane as a `finding` for that seat's own triage.
